q01:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS flights_count FROM fact_flight
```
q02:
```sql
SELECT al.airline_type, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 AND f.delay_minutes <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key GROUP BY 1
```
q03:
```sql
SELECT AVG(f.delay_minutes) AS avg_delay_min FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.month = 7
```
q04:
```sql
SELECT d.month, SUM(f.passengers) AS passengers FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY 1
```
q05:
```sql
SELECT c.class_label AS cause_class, SUM(f.delay_minutes) AS total_delay_min FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE f.cancelled = 0 AND c.class_label <> 'No delay' GROUP BY 1
```
q06:
```sql
SELECT o.iata || '-' || de.iata AS route, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_airport o ON f.origin_airport_key = o.airport_key JOIN dim_airport de ON f.dest_airport_key = de.airport_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY flights DESC, route LIMIT 5
```
q07:
```sql
SELECT ac.aircraft_type, 100.0 * SUM(f.passengers) / NULLIF(SUM(f.seats), 0) AS load_factor FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_aircraft ac ON f.aircraft_key = ac.aircraft_key GROUP BY 1
```
q08:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_weather FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE f.cancelled = 1 AND c.class_label = 'Weather'
```
q09:
```sql
SELECT al.name AS airline, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.cancelled = 0 AND f.delay_minutes <= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY on_time_rate DESC LIMIT 1
```
q10:
```sql
SELECT d.season, SUM(f.revenue) / SUM(f.passengers) AS revenue_per_pax FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY 1
```
q11:
```sql
SELECT al.airline_type, AVG(f.delay_minutes) AS avg_delay_min FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key JOIN dim_airline al ON f.airline_key = al.airline_key WHERE d.season = 'Summer' GROUP BY 1
```
q12:
```sql
SELECT c.subclass_label AS cause_subclass, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM fact_flight f JOIN dim_delay_cause c ON f.delay_cause_key = c.delay_cause_key WHERE c.class_label = 'Weather' AND f.delay_minutes > 60 GROUP BY 1
```
